synthesizedFacts.fact: Rosacea is linked to gastrointestinal diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease, celiac disease, irritable bowel syndrome, gastroesophageal reflux disease, Helicobacter pylori infection, and small intestine bacterial overgrowth.
The gut-skin axis suggests that gut microbiota plays a significant role in the pathogenesis of rosacea, influencing inflammatory responses.
Probiotics and dietary changes may help manage rosacea symptoms by modulating gut microbiota and reducing inflammation.
